q: Two buses, $M$ and $Z$, always arrive at fixed numbers of minutes past the hour, and only one bus comes each hour. You arrive at random times over the course of a year and observe that you are much more likely to catch bus $M$ than bus $Z$. Given that $Z$ arrives during the first half of the hour, what can you deduce about the arrival times $m$ and $z$ of the two buses?
